after.text: Completed the requested visual discussion and source inspection. Resources: research-and-visual-proposal.md, UNRESOLVED_QUESTIONS.md, context-installation.html and cli-acquisition.html. Binary scope is skill-required CLI packages. Findings: current source/cache plans require trusted Go fingerprinting; installed shims do not require the compiler; source registry matches cannot admit binary subjects. Proposed path/collection, typed-context and prebuilt admission contracts are explicitly non-normative. Existing managed-home MCP wiring is distinguished from new metadata import/project writing. Apple standalone ticket stapling and native execution compatibility require a real packaging spike; no downloaded binary was tested. Headless QA passed for both explainers at 736/360/320px in light/dark with interaction/failure-route checks and no overflow/script errors; first 320px overflow was fixed. Evidence: /Users/iv/Developer/ReluxWorks/curator-spec/.temp/curator-context-visual/visual-qa-01.json, visual-qa-02.log and artifact-validation-01.json. Four board resource copies matched byte-for-byte. No tracked curator-spec changes; unrelated adjacent checkout changes preserved.
